content_sections.heading: About APS Kota
content_sections.text: Army Public School, Kota is an English-medium co-education school on Mala Road, Kota – 324001. Its letterhead describes it as a private unaided school with CBSE Affiliation No. 1780012. The medium of instruction is English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification, given below in the notice's order. For all subjects except Hindi and Sanskrit, candidates must be proficient in spoken English, as the medium of instruction is English. Two years integrated Post Graduate MA/M.Sc. Course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% aggregate marks; OR Post-Graduation with minimum 50% marks or equivalent grade and three-year integrated B.Ed/M.Ed.; OR Master Degree from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the subject: Chemistry – Chemistry/Bio chemistry; English – English; Political Science – Political Science. B.Ed. or equivalent degree from a NCTE recognized university/Institution with minimum 50% aggregate marks. Proficiency in teaching in English and Hindi. Knowledge of Computer Application. Experience (for experienced candidates): for the PGT category the candidate should have worked as at least PGT/TGT for 5 years in the last 10 years. Four years Integrated Degree Course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate; OR Post-Graduation with a minimum 50% marks or equivalent grade and three-year integrated B.Ed./M.Ed.; OR Bachelor Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects/combination of subjects and in aggregate, as below. B.Ed. or equivalent degree from a recognized university. Proficiency in teaching in English and Hindi medium, and knowledge of Computer Application. Graduation in Psychology with a certificate or Diploma in counseling. Minimum 03 years experience as Wellness Teachers/Counsellor in CBSE School. MA (Music) or M Music of any recognized University, OR Hr Sec/Sr Sec with any of the following: Sangeet Alankar (M Music), All India Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Mandal, Bombay, 8 years; OR Sangeet Kovid (M Music), Indira Kala Sangeet Viswavidyalaya, Khairagarh, 8 years. Sangeet Praveen (M Music), The Prayag Sangeet Samiti Allahabad, 8 years; OR Sangeet Nipun (M Music), The Bhatkhande Sangeet Vidyapeeth Lucknow, 8 years. B.A in Music followed by a minimum of 2 years Diploma/Certificate in Music from an institute recognized by State/Central Government. Hr Sec/Sr Sec with a minimum of 7 years/8 years Diploma Certificate in Music from an Institute recognized by State/Central Government. Sangeet/Nritya Visharad of Prachin Kala Kendra, Chandigarh with graduation in any discipline. The notice prints the same qualification for both posts. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for APS Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hard copies of all supporting documents with the screenshot of the payment of Rs 250/- must be sent to the school by post by 06 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for APS Kota PGT posts?
faq.answer: A PGT needs a two-year integrated MA/M.Sc. of RCE (NCERT), or post-graduation with 50% and three-year integrated B.Ed/M.Ed, or a Master Degree with 50% in the subject, plus B.Ed with 50% from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for APS Kota teacher posts?
faq.answer: For PGT, TGT and most PRT posts, fresh candidates must be below 40 years and experienced candidates below 57 years as on 01 April 2027; pre-primary posts require 25 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for APS Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 250/-; the screenshot of the payment must be sent by post with the hard copies of the supporting documents.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for APS Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in and submit the form online at www.apskota.in, then post the hard copies of your documents with the screenshot of the Rs 250/- payment in a sealed envelope, with the post name written on it, by 06 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for APS Kota posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on QR/Experience/Merit, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, whose date will be intimated later.

faq.question: Q7. Is APS Kota a government job?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes Army Public School, Kota as a private unaided school.

faq.question: Q8. Is CTET or TET required for APS Kota PRT posts?
faq.answer: Yes. PRT (All Subjects) and PRT (Art & Craft) Teacher require a pass in CTET/TET conducted by CBSE/State Govt.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for UDC, LDC and Receptionist at APS Kota?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years as on 01 April 2027, and up to 55 years for ESM clerks.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate with a diploma in music apply for PRT (Music Teacher)?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates who have obtained a diploma in music are not eligible for PRT (Music Teacher); the same applies to a diploma in dance for PRT (Dance Teacher).
